facts.fact: The Ministry says the right of access is governed by law no. 31-13, adopted 22 February 2018 and published in the Bulletin officiel on 12 March 2018.
The Ministry says a convention signed in 2025 transferred the national portal to the Commission du droit d'accès à l'information, which launched a new version at pndai.ma.
